title: Nokē Smart Entry Hits 500,000 Devices & Wins Innovation Award
summary: Noke Smart Entry surpasses 500,000 devices and wins the Best Technology Innovation Award, highlighting advancements in self-storage security.
body_markdown:
## **Janus International Group’s Nokē™ Smart Entry Surpasses 500,000 Installed Devices & Wins Industry Innovation Award**


## *Nokē Achieves Milestone & Wins Inside Self-Storage Best Technology Innovation Award for the 5th Time*


**


TEMPLE, GA, SEPTEMBER ,


****8 2026**** – Janus International Group, Inc. (NYSE: JBI) (“Janus” or the “Company”), a leading global manufacturer and provider of turnkey self-storage, commercial, and industrial building solutions, recently announced that its award-winning Nokē Smart Entry platform surpassed 500,000 smart devices installed worldwide,


marking a significant milestone in the continued adoption of smart security and facility automation technology across the self-storage industry.


In conjunction with this milestone, Nokē Smart Entry by Janus received the 2026 Inside Self-Storage Best of Business Award for “Best Technology Innovation” for the fifth time


. The Inside Self-Storage "Best of Business" reader-choice poll is voted on by industry professionals who elect their favorite suppliers in 40 categories. Janus is the only five-time winner of Inside Self-Storage’s “Best Technology Innovation” award, a distinction that underscores the Company’s sustained commitment to advancing technology and innovation across the self-storage industry.


“Surpassing 500,000 installed devices is an important milestone for Nokē and demonstrates the growing demand for connected technology across the self-storage industry,” said Ramey Jackson, Chief Executive Officer of Janus. “We’re also pleased to win the Best Technology Innovation award again this year. Neither the award nor the milestone would be possible without our customers as well as the hard work of each and every member of our team.”


Nokē Smart Entry is a fully integrated smart entry and security platform designed specifically for self-storage. The system combines smart locks, intelligent keypads, a mobile-first tenant experience, and a cloud-based management portal to create a connected ecosystem across individual units and facility entry points.


For owner-operators, Nokē Smart Entry provides real-time visibility into facility activity while helping automate traditionally manual processes such as lock checks, overlocking, move-ins, and digital key management. For tenants, the Nokē Smart Entry mobile app provides convenient smartphone entry to gates, doors, elevators, and individual storage units while eliminating the need for traditional keys and padlocks.


With more than half a million smart devices now installed worldwide, Nokē continues to assist self-storage owners and operators modernize facilities through connected smart security and automation


. The milestone underscores the growing adoption of Nokē Smart Entry technology as operators seek scalable solutions that enhance security, improve operational efficiency, enable remote facility management, and elevate the tenant experience.


To learn more about Nokē Smart Entry by Janus, visit:


[www.janusintl.com/products/noke](https://www.janusintl.com/products/noke) .


###


## **About Nokē Smart Entry**


The Nokē Smart Entry system by Janus International Group is a complete digital smart entry solution comprised of smart locks, smart keypads, keyless facility entry points, mobile applications, and a cloud-based management portal. Designed specifically for self-storage, Nokē helps owners and operators enhance individual unit security, automate operational processes, gain greater visibility across their facilities, and provide tenants with convenient mobile entry.


## **About Janus International Group**


Janus International Group, Inc. (


[www.JanusIntl.com](http://www.janusintl.com/) ) is a leading global manufacturer and provider of turnkey self-storage, commercial, and industrial building solutions, including: roll-up and swing doors, hallway systems, single- and multi-story steel buildings, building components, relocatable storage units, and smart security and locking technologies. The Janus team operates out of several U.S. and international locations.
